view.scene_description: A modern bookstore or library interior with wooden bookshelves filled with books. A person in a white jacket sits at a desk near a large window, working on a laptop. The space features warm lighting, decorative circular lights, and a curved wooden platform. Green plants add natural elements to the environment.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a white hooded jacket and glasses is seated at a desk, focused on a laptop. They are positioned near a large window on the left side of the frame. Their posture suggests concentration. A brown bag rests beside them on the chair.

objects.label: laptop
objects.observation: An open laptop is placed on a dark wooden desk in front of the person. Its screen is illuminated, indicating active use. The keyboard and trackpad are visible. It is directly in front of the person’s hands.

objects.label: bookshelf
objects.observation: A large wooden bookshelf with multiple shelves filled with books occupies the central background. The shelves are illuminated from within, casting a warm glow. It extends across much of the midground and is partially obscured by the person and a plant.

objects.label: window
objects.observation: A large glass window on the far left allows bright natural light into the room. Trees and foliage are visible outside. The window frames the left edge of the scene and illuminates the person and nearby desk area.

objects.label: plant
objects.observation: A tall green leafy plant stands between the person and the bookshelf. Its broad leaves extend upward and slightly outward. It is positioned on the floor, partially obscuring the view of the bookshelf behind it.

objects.label: desk
objects.observation: A dark wooden desk with a smooth surface holds the laptop and other items. It is located in the foreground, directly in front of the seated person. The desk extends toward the left edge of the frame.

objects.label: chair
objects.observation: A modern-style chair with a metal frame and dark seat is occupied by the person. It is positioned at the desk, facing inward. The backrest is partially visible behind the person’s shoulders.

objects.label: bag
objects.observation: A brown leather or fabric tote bag hangs from the chair’s armrest. It has visible straps and appears to contain items. It is positioned to the right of the person, resting against the chair.

objects.label: ceiling_light
objects.observation: Circular recessed lights are embedded in the ceiling above the bookshelf area. One prominent circular light fixture is visible on the right wall, emitting warm light. Additional smaller lights are scattered across the ceiling.

objects.label: curved_platform
objects.observation: A wide, curved wooden platform extends from the bookshelf area toward the right side of the frame. It is illuminated by under-cabinet lighting and appears to serve as a stage or reading nook. Several people are visible in the background near its edge.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000012", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
